'''Troax''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who participated in the [[Skirmish on Dac]], serving under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Sturves]] on board the ''[[Sea Lion]]''.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The fight/flight deck is flooding, commander.|Lieutenant Troax to Commander Sturves|<ref name="Legacy 32" />}}
Troax was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] who served under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Sturves]] on board the ''[[Sea Lion]]''. Following [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s decree that all the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] were to be [[Genocide on Dac|exterminated]], Troax and the crew of the ''[[Sea Lion]]'' were dispatched to [[Skirmish on Dac|hunt down]] Mon Calamari civilians that had fled into the depths of the planet's oceans.<ref name="Legacy 32" />

The ''Sea Lion'' dispatched [[Shark Squadron]], a unit of [[Shark underwater fighter|Shark]] subfighters, to destroy a refugee settlement. However, [[Mon Calamari Rangers]] under the command of [[Tanquar]] attacked the squadron with their [[Krakana underwater fighter|Krakana fighter craft]]. As the squadron began to take casualties, Commander Sturves ordered Troax to get a group of [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper|seatroopers]] into the water. Troax sent [[Alpha Squadron (seatrooper)|Alpha Squadron]] to deal with the threat, but they were ambushed by [[Imperial Knight]] [[Treis Sinde]] upon leaving the ''Sea Lion''; none of the squad survived. Sinde infiltrated the ''Sea Lion'', badly damaging the [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] and causing the ship to flood. Troax notified Commander Sturves of the ship taking on water, and Sturves immediately sounded the retreat. Troax recalled Shark Squadron to cover their departure, and the Imperials left the battlefield.<ref name="Legacy 32" />

==Behind the scenes==
Troax played a minor role in the [[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' (2006) 32]], the first issue of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''{{'s}} [[Star Wars: Legacy: Fight Another Day|''Fight Another Day'']] story arc.<ref name="Legacy 32" />
